title: Marking an In and an Out and pressing one key takes that stretch out
goal: Cutting a five minute recording to ninety seconds is mostly throwing away long stretches. In Premiere you mark an In and an Out and press the apostrophe (Extract) and the stretch is gone with the gap closed, or semicolon (Lift) to leave a gap. Here the marks can be set but nothing removes what they enclose, so each stretch costs two cuts, a click on the piece and Delete.
notes: Found by measure-the-video-editor-against-premiere-and-fi (2026-09-24); gap report docs/design/video-vs-premiere.md. Reproduced: five-minute walk, videoSeekQuarter, i, videoSeekMiddle, o (both taken by timeline, green span drawn: in-out-marked.jpg), then shift+delete: 'taken by responder chain', nothing removed (after-shift-delete.jpg). No Extract or Lift exists in Sources (grep). TimelineKeyCommand has lift/rippleDelete for the PICKED clip only. Pairs with cutting-a-stretch-out-of-a-recording-takes-its-c (captions following a cut).
acceptance: With an In and an Out set, the apostrophe removes that stretch from every unlocked track and closes the gap, in one undo step
Semicolon removes the stretch and leaves the gap
Right-click on the marked stretch of the ruler offers both, with their keys
Captions and titles inside the stretch go with it (or the task that makes cuts carry captions is named as the dependency)
A walk marks 1:15 to 2:30 on a five minute recording, extracts it, and the timeline reads 3:45
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: digest 2026-09-24: cutting-a-stretch-out-of-a-recording-takes-its-c now runs first and is a dependency, so Extract and Lift inherit captions, titles and sounds following the removed stretch instead of solving it twice.

The document-level stretch removal this needs landed 2026-09-24: PhotonzDocument.removeTime(fromMS:toMS:exceptLayer:) in Sources/PhotonzCore/StretchRemoval.swift drops captions and titles wholly inside, shortens words and shapes across either end (caption words squeezed with them), moves everything after earlier, lands a sound starting inside on the join, and leaves a sound across the whole stretch alone. Extract can cut every clip at In and Out and call it once.

Adversarial review before building: a Premiere editor expects ' and ; with In/Out marks, acting on every unlocked track (music included), one undo step, marks cleared afterwards, playhead on the join. Gaps the app had: a clip cannot hold a hole (ClipPieces), so Lift cutting a clip across the stretch has to make it two layers on the same track (tracks written down first so the copy stays on the clip's track). removeTime leaves a sound across the stretch alone; Extract must cut it, so clips are cut through their own pieces first and removeTime handles everything else. Keys gated on the timeline having the keyboard, like I/O, so ' and ; never fire while typing on the canvas.

Built: Sources/PhotonzCore/MarkedStretch.swift (ClipPieces.removingStretch, extractStretch/liftStretch, extractMarkedStretch/liftMarkedStretch: markers after move up, one inside lands on the join, marks cleared). removeTime(exceptLayers:) plus removeLayersEmptyingCaptions factored in StretchRemoval.swift. TimelineKeyCommand .extractMarked/.liftMarked on ' and ;. App: EditorState+TimelineMenus (canTakeOutMarkedStretch, extract/liftMarkedStretch; ruler menu leads with Extract and Lift when the click is on the stretch, ends included, since the ruler sits at the foot of the screen and the long menu scrolled them out of sight), Mark menu rows. Walk harness: action clipHoldToFiveMinutes, expectTimeline lengthMS. Tests: Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/MarkedStretchTests.swift (20). Full suite 9581 green. Walks extract-a-marked-stretch-walk (lock-safe, no flags: 5:00, I at 1:15, O at 2:30, ' -> 3:45, cmd-Z -> 5:00 with marks, ; -> gap) and extract-from-the-ruler-menu-walk ok, plus timeline-right-click, premiere-keys-on-the-timeline, timeline-keys-on-open ok.

left rough (not filed, in the audit for the user to react to): Lift's tail is named '<name> copy' per the app's duplicate-naming rule where Premiere keeps the name; motion keys on a layer Lift cuts in two replay from the tail's start (same as other clip cuts, unverified in a walk); a walk's synthesized pointer never reaches the ruler's onContinuousHover (the move step logs 'nothing under the pointer watches for one'), so ruler right-clicks in walks act at the playhead. No mock page draws Extract/Lift; nearest is video.html's ruler.

Extract (') and Lift (;) on an In/Out stretch, every unlocked track, one undo step, captions/titles/markers follow (Sources/PhotonzCore/MarkedStretch.swift; keys, Mark menu, ruler right-click leading with both). 20 core tests, full suite 9581 green; walks extract-a-marked-stretch-walk (5:00 marked 1:15-2:30, extract reads 3:45, no flags, real captures) and extract-from-the-ruler-menu-walk pass; audit queue/audits/2026-09-24-extract-and-lift.json.
